lastCompletedStory.title: Reconcile Recent feed 'incomplete' against live prd.json passes

nextStoryContext: readRecentProgress(cwd, userStories?: readonly PrdStory[]) and parseRecentProgress(jsonl, passingStoryIds?: ReadonlySet<string>) now reconcile a frozen 'incomplete' result event to 'done' when the same-story prd.json passes:true (live state threaded from readSnapshot's prd?.userStories, same source Dashboard.tsx:445 reads). Only 'incomplete' is reconciled; all other outcomes pass through verbatim. The event log itself is never rewritten -- reconciliation happens only in the read/summary layer. No src/supervisor/{events,result,loop}.ts edits were needed or made. Raised scripts/file-size-budget.json ceilings for src/commands/dashboard.ts (1084->1104) and test/dashboard.test.ts (1901->1953) with a dated _ref note (CAM-346).
